never: invoice a job the system has not marked complete
type, average or recall a rate; the price book is the only source
bill a variation with no signed acceptance attached
make a second invoice for one job
serve, certify or argue a claim
stays_with_person: the release, or the rule and threshold that stands in for it
the variation, and arguments about what was agreed
the claim under security of payment law, with the builder and their advisor

provider_block.job: the invoice is out the day the job finishes

checks.title: The job's completion is the only trigger
Every invoice line traces to a line on the job
Every line is priced from the price book, and a line the book does not cover parks the invoice
A variation is billed only with a signed acceptance attached
A job under a building contract is invoiced as a stage invoice, and the claim stays with the builder
One invoice per job, written once, updated on a second event
The invoice exists in the ledger the business runs, with an external id back
Nothing is sent without a release by a person, or by a rule a person set with a threshold
A parked invoice is a queue with a reason and an owner, and nothing parked is sent
Job id, invoice id, the lines, the rates read, who released and when it was sent are retrievable by job
